items.title: Master Opening
items.text:
MASTER OPENING SCENE — PANCHATANTRA STORY SERIES (10 SECONDS)
VIDEO PROMPT:
Create a grand, cinematic 10-second opening title sequence for a Panchatantra animated story. This opening must maintain a consistent visual identity across the entire Panchatantra series while featuring unique characters, environments and visual elements from the particular story.
ANIMATION STYLE — FIXED FOR ALL STORIES:
Beautiful hand-painted 2D watercolor storybook animation inspired by traditional Indian illustrated children's storybooks. Rich watercolor textures, delicate artistic outlines, beautifully painted backgrounds, expressive animal characters, natural movements, atmospheric lighting, soft gradients and cinematic composition. Use sophisticated traditional Indian visual detailing with a magical storytelling atmosphere.
STRICTLY AVOID Pixar-style 3D, Disney-style 3D, CGI, photorealism, plastic-looking characters, glossy 3D textures or modern cartoon rendering.
CHARACTER AND ENVIRONMENT INPUTS — CUSTOMIZE FOR EACH STORY:
- Story Title: [INSERT STORY NAME]
- Hindi Subtitle: [INSERT STORY SUBTITLE / ALTERNATIVE STORY NAME, IF ANY]
- Main Characters: [INSERT MAIN CHARACTERS WITH THEIR VISUAL APPEARANCE]
- Story Environment: [FOREST / LAKE / PALACE / VILLAGE / MOUNTAINS / OTHER STORY-SPECIFIC LOCATION]
- Signature Visual Element: [INSERT A UNIQUE OBJECT, ACTION OR SYMBOL FROM THE STORY]
- Opening Narration: [INSERT STORY-SPECIFIC HINDI NARRATION]
0:00–0:03 — GRAND STORY INTRODUCTION:
Begin with an extremely wide, cinematic aerial establishing shot of the story's most beautiful and recognizable environment. The landscape should immediately communicate the atmosphere of the upcoming story.
Introduce the main characters through a visually engaging action that represents the central theme of the story. Show their natural movements, expressive faces and interactions with their surroundings.
The camera smoothly glides forward through the environment, revealing the characters in an exciting, magical and visually captivating composition.
IMPORTANT: Do not use generic character introductions. Select a visually interesting action that creates curiosity about the actual story.
0:03–0:05 — CINEMATIC TRANSITION:
The camera moves closer to the main characters or follows the signature visual element of the story. Introduce a beautiful transition using floating watercolor particles, soft golden light, delicate clouds, glowing dust or other story-appropriate visual effects.
The original environment gradually transforms into a sophisticated title-reveal background.
0:05–0:09 — GRAND TITLE REVEAL:
Reveal an elegant ancient Indian manuscript-inspired title composition.
As the camera advances, reveal the following exact Hindi title in elegant, decorative Devanagari lettering:
"पंचतंत्र कथा"
"[INSERT MAIN STORY TITLE]"
"[INSERT HINDI SUBTITLE / ALTERNATIVE TITLE IF APPLICABLE]"
Arrange the title in three visually balanced lines. The main story name must be the largest and most prominent heading.
Use a consistent warm golden and cream-colored treatment with subtle traditional Indian ornamental detailing, delicate floral motifs and an elegant decorative frame.
The title should appear through a beautiful golden shimmer, as if being revealed on an ancient illustrated manuscript.
Keep the text large, sharp, correctly spelled and readable against a darker, story-appropriate watercolor background.
0:09–0:10 — FINAL TITLE HOLD:
Hold the complete title prominently on screen. Allow golden particles to sparkle gently around the decorative frame. Include small illustrated silhouettes or visual motifs of the story's main characters near the bottom or sides of the title composition, without obstructing the text.
Finish with a smooth cinematic transition into Scene 01 of the actual story.
CAMERA DIRECTION:
Smooth aerial establishing shot → forward cinematic tracking → character-focused movement → magical transition → slow dolly-in toward the title → steady final title composition.
VFX:
Beautiful watercolor clouds, floating golden particles, atmospheric sunlight, delicate ornamental patterns, magical title-reveal shimmer, subtle glowing edges and smooth cinematic transitions.
SFX:
Story-appropriate environmental ambience, gentle wind, character-specific natural sounds, magical title-reveal chime and a deep, resonant cinematic impact.
BACKGROUND MUSIC:
Grand Indian orchestral storytelling music featuring flute, santoor, strings and traditional Indian percussion. Begin with a mysterious and adventurous mood, gradually build anticipation and reach a majestic musical accent during the title reveal.
NARRATION — WARM, GRAND HINDI STORYTELLER VOICE:
"प्रस्तुत है पंचतंत्र की एक रोचक नीति कथा—[INSERT STORY TITLE], यानी [INSERT SIMPLE HINDI STORY DESCRIPTION]!"
VOICE CONSISTENCY:
Use the same warm, expressive, mature Hindi storyteller voice throughout the Panchatantra series. Maintain consistent pronunciation, vocal character, recording quality and storytelling energy.
STRICT SERIES-WIDE INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Duration must be exactly 10 seconds.
2. Maintain the same hand-painted 2D watercolor storybook animation style in every story.
3. Keep the title-reveal composition, golden typography, traditional Indian ornamental treatment and overall visual identity consistent across the series.
4. Customize the opening environment, characters, signature visual action and background according to each individual story.
5. Every opening must visually introduce the actual story rather than use unrelated generic footage.
6. Narration must be complete, correctly pronounced and must not omit any words.
7. The three-line title must be correctly spelled and readable.
8. No additional words, subtitles, captions, random text, logos or watermarks.
9. Use cinematic 16:9 framing with beautiful wide-angle compositions.
10. End with a smooth transition into the first actual story scene.
